ma.getFileSystemManager()

Obtain the globally unique file manager(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Return value

FileSystemManager

File Manager

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.readFile({
  filePath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/testFile.txt`,
  encoding: "utf8",
  success: (res) => {
    console.log(res);
  }
});
